description: Visual transcription of the 8 base-game Ancient One sheet scans stored in jesseflorig/arkham-horror-json (images/ancient-ones). Doom track = number of printed doom spaces (highest number).
method: manual visual transcription by the pipeline author (Claude) on 2026-10-14; not OCR

records.name: Azathoth
records.worshippers: Since Azathoth promises nothing except destruction, only the insane worship him. However, their fanaticism gives them strength. Maniacs have their toughness increased by 1.
records.power: If Azathoth awakens, the game is over and the investigators lose.
records.attack: The end is here! Azathoth destroys the world.

records.name: Cthulhu
records.worshippers: Cthulhu's worshippers often have the Innsmouth Look, a sign of monstrous ancestors. Cultists have a horror rating of -2 and a horror damage of 2 Sanity.
records.power: While Cthulhu stirs in his slumber, investigators have their maximum Sanity and maximum Stamina reduced by 1.
records.attack: Each investigator lowers either his maximum Sanity or maximum Stamina by 1 (his choice). After Cthulhu attacks, 1 doom token is placed back on Cthulhu's doom track if it isn't already full.

records.name: Hastur
records.worshippers: Hastur's worshippers ride byakhee mounts that they call with enchanted whistles. Cultists are flying monsters and their combat rating is -2.
records.power: While Hastur stirs in his slumber, the cost to seal a gate is 8 Clue tokens instead of 5.
records.start_of_battle: X is set to the current terror level.
records.attack: Each investigator must pass a Luck (+1) check or lose 2 Sanity. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

records.name: Ithaqua
records.worshippers: Ithaqua's worshippers eat the flesh of their fellow men, gaining supernatural power through their dark practice. Cultists have their toughness increased by 2.
records.power: While Ithaqua stirs in his slumber, any investigator in a street area at the end of the Mythos Phase loses 1 Stamina. In addition, all Weather cards are discarded without their special effects taking place.
records.start_of_battle: Investigators must roll a die for every item they have, discarding the item on a failure.
records.attack: Each investigator must pass a Fight (+1) check or lose 2 Stamina. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

records.name: Nyarlathotep
records.worshippers: Nyarlathotep has innumerable cults all over the world. Cultists have the Endless ability.
records.power: At the start of the game, add the 5 Mask monsters to the cup. Multiple Mask monsters can be in play at once.
records.start_of_battle: Any investigator with no Clue tokens is devoured.
records.attack: Each investigator must pass a Lore (+1) check or lose 1 Clue token. Any investigator with no Clue tokens left is devoured. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

records.name: Shub-Niggurath
records.worshippers: Shub-Niggurath's young are numberless. Dark Young have the Endless ability.
records.power: While Shub-Niggurath stirs in her slumber, all monsters have their toughness increased by 1.
records.start_of_battle: Any investigator with no monster trophies is devoured.
records.attack: Each investigator must pass a Sneak (+1) check or lose 1 monster trophy. Any investigator with no monster trophies left is devoured. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

records.name: Yig
records.worshippers: Yig's worshippers are actually disguised serpent people. Their bite is highly poisonous. Cultists have a combat rating of +0 and a combat damage of 4 Stamina.
records.power: While Yig stirs in his slumber, he gains a doom token whenever a Cultist is defeated or an investigator is lost in time and space.
records.start_of_battle: Every investigator is Cursed. Any investigator that already has a Curse is devoured.
records.attack: Each investigator must pass a Speed (+1) check or lose 1 Sanity and 1 Stamina. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

records.name: Yog-Sothoth
records.worshippers: Yog-Sothoth's worshippers have powerful magical abilities. Cultists have Magical Immunity and a combat rating of -1.
records.power: While Yog-Sothoth stirs in his slumber, the difficulty to close or seal a gate increases by 1. In addition, any investigator lost in time and space is devoured.
records.start_of_battle: Any investigator with no gate trophies is devoured.
records.attack: Each investigator must pass a Will (+1) check or lose 1 gate trophy. Any investigator with no gate trophies left is devoured. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)
